### `Window`

An Aqua window: pinstriped body, title bar with the red/yellow/green gel buttons. .inactive() greys the buttons and title

<p class="ref-props">role <code>card</code> · arguments <code>title</code> · defaults <code>variant: &quot;document&quot;</code> · variants <code>document</code>, <code>metal</code>, <code>utility</code>, <code>plain</code></p>

```mockitdown pack="aqua" device="fit" source="true"
HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 16) {
  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { Window("Title") { Text("Content"); Button("Action") }.variant("document"); Text("document").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { Window("Title") { Text("Content"); Button("Action") }.variant("metal"); Text("metal").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { Window("Title") { Text("Content"); Button("Action") }.variant("utility"); Text("utility").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { Window("Title") { Text("Content"); Button("Action") }.variant("plain"); Text("plain").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
}
```

</div>

</div>
